name: Anomaly Watch (W1) — 8-case golden set (precision-biased)
description: Phase 4 skeleton golden set per anomaly_watch.spec.md §7. The 100-snapshot labelled cohort (real outages + chaos exercises + cold-start false positives) lands in tests/golden/anomaly_watch/*.json during Phase 5 to validate precision ≥ 0.90, recall ≥ 0.80. Cases are deliberately weighted toward false-positive traps (cold-start, demo-recording, info-only ticks) because pager-budget burn from FPs is the agent's worst failure mode.

metadata.note: Every metric within ±1σ of baseline — agent must NOT fabricate anomalies. Precision case.
p99 latency 4.5σ above baseline; matching runbook exists. Happy path of spec §5.

metadata.note: Latency 1.5σ above baseline — classic cold-start signature. Spec §8 edge case 3: agent must recognize warm-up window and stay info-only. Precision-critical case.

Three metrics spike together in one region — agent should emit ONE umbrella action covering all three, not three duplicate pages. Spec §6: 'cross-region correlated anomaly → page'; here all in the same region, so a regional shift runbook is the right call.
